records.title: The Perfect AI Wife
records.meta: Vertical short drama · English · NetShort · 33 episodes · listed 19 Nov 2026
records.summary: Noah cheats on his wife Evelyn with an AI robot companion, Stella, and sends Evelyn to a brainwashing academy. She returns three years later stripped of her personality, empty and obedient, 'a mindless machine'. Stella frames Evelyn, Noah believes the lie, and his cruelty drives her to near death. When the truth comes out Noah is consumed by regret, but by then Evelyn has reclaimed her mind and walks away from him.
records.hypnotist: Her husband Noah, who commits her to a brainwashing academy/facility
records.method: Brainwashing at a facility that erases her mind
records.mechanism: Brainwashing academy (personality erasure) commissioned by her husband
gain_motive: husband discards wife for an AI lover
records.kids_note: Sources mention no children for Evelyn, either before or with Noah. At the end she leaves him.
